Class Delivery<K,V>

java.lang.Object
io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.api.Delivery<K,V>
Type Parameters:
K - key type
V - value type
public final class Delivery<K,V> extends Object
One message, established as causally deliverable and handed to application logic.

Every cause of this message has already been delivered to this process. Reserved headers carrying causal metadata are removed before construction, so headers() shows only what the application itself sent.
